links.outcome: Agreement between AI-assigned and surgeon-assigned rubric scores on simulated consent encounters
links.effect: AI assigned higher performance scores than surgeons, with significant differences on several items (all P = 0.03), indicating systematic discordance with surgeon assessment despite higher feedback quality (mCCERR 38.5 vs 24.75, P = 0.04).
links.quote: AI assigned higher performance scores than surgeons, with significant differences in addressing patient emotions, explaining the procedure, risks, and alternatives, and avoiding coercion (all P = 0.03).

unlisted_practices: Using LLM-generated feedback for formative evaluation of trainee informed consent skills, paired with human oversight

screen.reason: Empirical study evaluating the performance and alignment of LLM-generated feedback and scoring compared to surgeons for simulated surgical informed consent encounters.
